+@pytest.mark.parametrize('am, stdin', [({'mode': {}}, {})], indirect=['am', 'stdin'])
+def test_new_file_warns_when_mode_omitted(atomic_am, tmpdir, mocker, capfd):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.common.warnings._global_warnings', [])
+    atomic_am.selinux_enabled.return_value = False
+    src = tmpdir.join('source')
+    dest = tmpdir.join('destination')
+    src.write('private contents')
+
+    atomic_am.atomic_move(str(src), str(dest))
+
+    assert stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(str(dest)).st_mode) & 0o077 == 0
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == {str(dest)}
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        atomic_am.exit_json()
+    result = json.loads(capfd.readouterr()[0])
+    assert result['warnings'] == [
+        "File '%s' created with default permissions '600'. The previous default was '666'. Specify 'mode' to avoid this warning." % dest
+    ]
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize('am, stdin', [({'mode': {}}, {})], indirect=['am', 'stdin'])
+def test_setting_mode_removes_only_that_paths_warning(atomic_am, tmpdir, mocker, capfd):
+    mocker.patch('ansible.module_utils.common.warnings._global_warnings', [])
+    atomic_am.selinux_enabled.return_value = False
+    destinations = []
+    for name in ('first', 'second', 'third'):
+        src = tmpdir.join(name + '.source')
+        dest = tmpdir.join(name)
+        src.write('contents')
+        atomic_am.atomic_move(str(src), str(dest))
+        destinations.append(str(dest))
+
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == set(destinations)
+    assert not atomic_am.set_mode_if_different(destinations[0], None, False)
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == set(destinations)
+    current_mode = '%03o' % stat.S_IMODE(os.stat(destinations[0]).st_mode)
+    assert not atomic_am.set_mode_if_different(destinations[0], current_mode, False)
+    assert atomic_am._created_files == set(destinations[1:])
+
+    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
+        atomic_am.exit_json()
+    result = json.loads(capfd.readouterr()[0])
+    assert result['warnings'] == [
+        "File '%s' created with default permissions '600'. The previous default was '666'. Specify 'mode' to avoid this warning." % path
+        for path in destinations[1:]
+    ]
